name: Torch of the Dormant Flame
summary: At the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, a shaman stands ready to kindle the Torch of the Dormant Flame. Its fire waits on an ember won atop a mountain in Durotar.

sections.title: Vessel of Awakening
sections.body: A shaman carries the unlit Torch of the Dormant Flame up the peaks above Durotar, seeking fire's favor. With fire sapta, the shaman sees a Minor Manifestation of Fire atop the mountain and challenges it. When the spirit falls, its glowing ember is placed in the weathered brazier at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Then the shaman touches the torch's head to the white-hot blaze, and the wood awakens as a burning emblem of elemental mastery.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Torch of the Dormant Flame?
aliases: why do i have this unlit torch
faq.answer: Shaman undertaking the Call of Fire trial receive the unlit ceremonial torch. After a manifestation of fire is defeated, its ember goes into the shrine's brazier. The shaman dips the torch into the white-hot flames, kindling it with elemental power.

faq.q: Where does this torch get lit?
aliases: where to light torch of dormant flame
faq.answer: The torch is lit atop the mountain near Telf Joolam in Durotar. After the Minor Manifestation of Fire is defeated, the shaman kindles it at the brazier of the Shrine of the Dormant Flame.

aliases: who gives torch of dormant flame
faq.answer: Kranal Fiss, the shaman living north of the Crossroads, gives initiates the unlit torch and sends them to Telf Joolam, keeper of the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Telf Joolam recognizes it as the mark of one attempting to tame fire.

angles.text: As a shaman, you begin with an unproven torch. Defeat a living manifestation of flame to kindle it and earn the right to summon a Fire Totem.
